summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Europort Istanbul 2026 phase 1. All 6 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend: Home hero visible (opacity 1), countdown non-zero (61 days), marquee present, 4 stat cards animate to 441/35/5,734/52, phase2 index has 8 chapters. Navbar links + logo present. Theme toggle: html.dark toggles, localStorage 'ep-theme' persists ('dark'/'light'), logo src swaps to /logo-europort-istanbul-navy.png in light. Brand Hub: title visible, all 10 sections (strategy/logo/color/type/graphic/components/motion/voice/benchmark/applications) present, section H2s reach opacity 1 after scroll (Reveal fix confirmed), 5 swatches present, swatch-copy-navy shows '#07255C' toast, logo-on-navy and logo-on-white images load (naturalWidth 2528 & 1742), 6 logo donts, all buttons/fields/form-submit present (submit stays on page), benchmark-table has 10 rows, motion-replay works. Report page: report-nav present, 6 tabs, tab2 loads different content containing 'SMM Hamburg', markdown table rendered, no report-error. No console errors on any page. Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow at body level on / or /brand.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `@app.on_event('shutdown')` is deprecated in FastAPI; consider lifespan handler (non-blocking).

server.py: CORS with allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins='*' is invalid per spec (browsers ignore credentials). CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*'; specify explicit origins in .env for production.
server.py imports motor and connects to MongoDB but no endpoint uses it — dead dependency for phase 1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (6 tests). Reveal animation opacity issue previously reported is verified fixed. Report content is Turkish by design. Swatch toast text contains raw hex like '#07255C'.
